profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Cribl
profile.summary:
I have been writing software for over twenty years, mainly applications related to transportation.  I have recently joined Cribl as a Staff Engineer, and I'm looking forward to diving into a new domain.

I've done traditional client-server, web, JEE, and, now, event-driven architectures running in a cloud provider.

I've managed a team of people having a diverse set of skills.

While in graduate school, I gained more than one year of university teaching object-oriented programming.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm the Technical Lead for the Distributed Management team at Cribl.

positions.title: Director of Technology Development
positions.description: I managed the design, development, and maintenance of three software platforms related to the collection and dissemination of traffic information (TrafficNet, SigAlert, and Blend).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was the Senior Software Engineer at Catalyst Communications, LLC.  I was responsible for the design and implementation of new software systems as well as handling ITS work satisfying the contract between Catalyst Communications and its partners.

positions.title: Senior Contractor
positions.description:
- Member of Strategic Platform Development Team
- Responsible for developing Corporate Technology Stack based on EJB3, Seam, and JSF
- Responsible for developing Core Component Catalog to be used by applications throughout the business.
- Responsible for consulting with other Development Teams responsible for developing and maintaining core business applications.

positions.title: Senior Java Architect
positions.description:
- Senior member of GDOT ITS Group commissioned to develop the next generation of GDOT Navigator Advanced Transportation Management System (ATMS)

- Responsible for design / implementation / testing of web-based user interface components and distributed, middle-tier JEE components.
